text: 眼镜上的用色，需要同时考虑显示特性、环境和用户认知。配色经过精细调整，以适应加色式显示，并让观看更舒适。应克制地使用颜色，让界面与现实环境协调；颜色可以用来强调重要操作、呈现图像，或传达具体含义。 在光学透视显示中，黑色呈现为透明。设计时要记住：深色会显得暗淡或透明；也可以利用这一特性营造深度感。 配色体系 眼镜的配色体系是一组用于定义应用主题的颜色令牌或颜色角色，由 3 种强调色角色、6 种界面底板色（或中性色）角色，以及各自对应的前景色角色组成。这里的颜色角色与手机端相似，使用方式也应保持一致。 强调色也可以用于前景内容，但应限于少量强调。 建议：以白色文字为主 大多数文字内容使用白色，需要强调的文字可以使用其他颜色。 避免：所有文字都使用彩色 不要给全部文字内容着色。 提示： Jetpack Compose Glimmer Figma 套件 包含颜色示意表，可以查看并定制各颜色角色及其数值。 定制颜色 为眼镜定制颜色时，关键是尽量减少视觉遮挡，并与现实环境协调。应优先保证内容在不同光照下都能读清。仔细平衡亮度与饱和度，让颜色能被迅速辨认。 主色可以使用品牌色或主要交互色。选择时，需要考虑对比度、饱和度以及功耗。 提示： 可以参考 Jetpack Compose Glimmer Skill ，辅助计算对比度指标。 优化品牌色与语义色 用于表达品牌、操作或系统警报的颜色，必须满足以下要求： 足够亮，保证内容可读。 具有足够的饱和度，使其呈现出可辨识的色彩。 在 HCT 色彩空间中，前景与背景的明度（Tone）差至少为 66%。 译者注：本页原文分别使用“66%”“明度差 70（7:1）”和“约 66”，表述不一致；这里保留各处原值。 进一步了解 Jetpack Compose Glimmer 主题 。 功耗 不同颜色的功耗和发热不同。如下图所示，在明度相同的条件下比较，绿色最省电，蓝色耗电最多。应尽量减少被点亮的像素数量。屏幕越亮，显示部件就越热；不要让全屏显示纯白，否则可能触发过热保护。 建议：检查各种背景下的对比度 考虑用户可能遇到的所有背景，检查界面与背景之间的对比度。 避免：界面在不同背景上对比不足 对比度不足可能造成视觉疲劳，让内容难以辨读。 为了在各种背景上保持足够对比，原文要求前景与背景颜色的明度差达到“70（7:1）”。可以将设计稿设为 Screen（滤色）混合模式进行检查。 建议：使用较低饱和度的颜色 使用较低饱和度的颜色。 避免：颜色过度饱和 过度饱和的颜色可能无法正确显示，并影响可读性。 应避免自行定制界面底板。 深色容器 容器通常必须把注意力留给其中的内容，避免自身形成干扰： 为了获得最高对比度，界面底板必须使用黑色。 处于焦点状态时，底板明度不应高于 34%，以保证前景元素清楚可读。 描边应看得见，但保持克制。 建议：深色底板，明亮内容 使用深色界面底板和明亮的前景内容。 避免：明亮或填色的底板 不要使用明亮或填色的界面底板。 建议：拉开底板与文字的明度 让底板与文字之间有足够对比；原文建议检查两者的明度差是否约为 66。 避免：底板与文字太接近 不要让底板和文字的明度过于接近，导致对比不足。 建议：让不同底板角色形成层次 确保 Surface 与 Surface Variants 之间有足够的明度差，以建立必要的视觉层次。 避免：不同底板角色明度过近 不要让 Surface 与其变体的明度过于接近；原文在此标注了“约 20 的差值”。 译者注：原文未说明“约 20”是建议差值还是反例数值。 可以定制描边，为界面加入品牌特征或更有表现力的视觉语言。 建议：使用默认颜色 默认颜色已针对眼镜显示进行了充分优化。 避免：同时使用多种描边色 不要让描边混用多种颜色。 注意：协调不同状态的描边颜色 定制颜色时，谨慎处理焦点状态与默认状态的描边，使两者保持协调。 以蓝色定制焦点描边：焦点高亮由两层描边组成，将颜色应用于第 2 层，即可为焦点状态着色。 建议：所有交互状态都有足够对比 确保界面在每种交互状态下都保持足够的对比度。 避免：交互状态对比度过低 不要把交互状态的对比度降得过低。

title: 字体与排版
description: 以视角衡量文字大小，并调整字形、字重和字距，让内容舒适且一眼可读。
body:
字体已针对带屏眼镜上的舒适阅读和一眼可读进行了优化，包括字号层级以及字体本身的字形特征。

Jetpack Compose Glimmer 提供了经过优化的默认字体层级，包含两种文字角色，每种角色各有三种样式。文字角色按照用途和信息层级划分。

在 Jetpack Compose Glimmer Figma 套件中，可以查看各文字角色、具体数值，以及它们在组件中的使用方式。

提示：Google Sans Flex 现已可在 Google Fonts 获取。

用视角衡量大小

眼镜上的界面，包括文字，以角度而非像素或点来衡量大小。视角表示界面在用户视野中占据多大范围。文字看起来有多大，会随它呈现的距离而变化。

文字的最小视角为 0.6°

大多数文字应处于 0.7°–0.9° 的范围。根据可读性研究，在任意给定深度，可读正文的最小视角约为 0.6°。要达到最低可读性指标，文字大小必须至少为 18 px。30 PPD × 最小视角 0.6° = 18 px（文字大小）。

定制字体

Google Sans Flex 等字体可以针对眼镜显示进一步优化。如果使用 Google Sans Flex，可以调整可变字体轴，让阅读体验更舒适：

  • 光学字号：针对不同字号（以点计）优化字形。
  • 圆润程度：通过圆润度轴调整字体的正式感。
  • 字重与字宽：提供较大的调整范围。

眼镜显示中的光晕和色差会使光线向四周扩散，让字形边界消失。圆润字形的几何结构更简单，因此有助于减轻这些影响。结合字距、字形以及一眼可读的大小一起调整，可以提高可读性和舒适度。

这些原则基于这一显示形态的光学特性。遵循它们，是获得舒适、清楚的阅读体验的关键。

建议：圆润、较粗，并留出字距

使用圆润字体，适当增加字重和字距。

避免：窄体、细字重的字体

不要使用窄体且字重较细的字体。
bodyEn:
Type is optimized for comfort and glanceability for display glasses this includes an optimized typescale and font family characteristics.

Jetpack Compose Glimmer has an optimized default typescale. Composed of two roles with 3 styles each, type roles are based on their purpose and hierarchy.

You can find the typescale roles and values in the Jetpack Compose Glimmer Figma kit, along with type role use in the components.

Note: Google Sans Flex is now available at fonts.google.com!

Measured in degrees

Interfaces, including text, on glasses are measured in angular degrees, not pixels or points. This unit of measurement corresponds to how much space UI takes up in the user's field of view. The size of type changes based on how far away it appears.

The minimum size for text is 0.6°

Most text should be between 0.7° - 0.9° Based on legibility research, the minimum size for readable body text is around 0.6° at any given depth. To meet the minimum legibility metric, text must be at least 18px in size. 30 PPD × 0.6° minimum = 18px text size.

Customize fonts

Fonts like Google Sans Flex can be optimized for glasses display. If using Google Sans Flex, you can optimize your font through variable font axes to make adjustments that create a more comfortable reading experience:

  • Optical size, optimizes letterforms for each point size
  • Roundness axis to adjust formality
  • Wide range of weights and widths

Halation and chromatic aberration in glasses displays spreads light in all directions, causing the boundaries of the letters to disappear. Rounded letterforms can mitigate halation and chromatic aberration in glasses displays due their simplified letterforms geometry. Consider letter spacing, letterform shape and glanceable sizing improves readability and comfort.

Here Google Sans Flex has been replaced with Nunito, a rounded font at an increased weight axes.

These principles are based on optical science for this specific display form-factor, and adhering to them is key to creating a comfortable and legible user experience.

Do

Use rounded fonts with increased weight and letter-spacing.

Don't

Use condensed thin typefaces.

title: 界面底板与层次
description: 通过底板、纵深和阴影组织内容，同时保持透视显示的清晰与舒适。
body:
界面底板用于承载内容或操作，在用户视野中形成清楚的视觉焦点。

用深度建立舒适感与层次

眼镜界面的深度感由纵深方向（Z 轴）上的位置与阴影共同构成，通过不同程度的视觉强调建立层次。

用底板颜色变体强调深度

使用 Surface Container Low 等底板颜色变体，通过更明显的对比强化深度感。阴影需要设为完全不透明的黑色，才能达到这一效果。

界面底板应始终保持透明，以便在大多数环境中获得尽可能高的对比度。

建议：使用滤色混合模式预览

务必将混合模式设为 Screen（滤色），预览界面底板在透明显示屏上的呈现效果。

避免：用正常混合模式判断效果

设计时不要使用 Normal（正常）混合模式，因为它无法呈现真实的视觉观感。
bodyEn:
Surfaces contain content. They provide clear focal points within the user's field of view, which can contain content or actions. 

Depth creates a sense of comfort and hierarchy

Depth on glasses is the combination of placement in z-space and shadows to establish a sense of hierarchy through varying levels of emphasis.

Use surface color variants to emphasize depth

Use surface color variants like Surface Container Low to create a more contrasting effect for depth. Shadows need to be fully opaque black to achieve effect.

Surfaces should always be transparent to maximize contrast in most environments.

Do

Make sure to set blend mode to screen to preview how UI surfaces will display on transparent displays.

Don't

Use normal blend mode while designing as it will not give a realistic perception.

title: 图标
description: 用圆润、较粗的线性图标，让用户一眼识别，并减轻光晕影响。
body:
眼镜上的图标必须一眼可读、容易辨认。使用圆润且笔画较粗的图标样式，避免光晕效应影响识别。

提示：如果不需要自定义图标，请使用 Material Symbols Rounded。
提示：可以在 Google Fonts 获取 Material Symbols 图标。
bodyEn:
Icons must be considered to be glanceable and discernible on glasses displays. Use rounded icon styles with a heavier weight to prevent halation effects.

Note: If you don't need custom iconography, use Material Symbols Rounded.

Note: For icons, check out Material Symbols. Available on Google Fonts.

title: 组件概览
description: 为透明显示屏量身设计的界面组件，兼顾可读性、舒适度与一致的交互体验。
body:
组件是为构建界面专门设计的基本单元。应用应采用 Jetpack Compose Glimmer 提供的组件；它们经过专门优化，适应 AI 眼镜显示屏特有的使用场景。

为透明显示屏优化

Glimmer 从多个方面优化了透明显示屏上的组件表现。

A. 底板颜色（Surface color）：界面底板需要具备透明效果，因此图中不透明的底色会改为黑色，使其呈现为透明。

B. 描边与高亮（Outline & Highlight）：描边颜色经过对比度优化。高亮能形成视觉表达，也可能用于指示某些输入方式。

C. 形状（Shape）：采用更柔和的形状体系，减少尖锐边角，让内容更容易一眼读懂，也更舒适。底板上的内容颜色（On Surface）使用白色，以尽可能拉开内容与现实背景的对比。

D. 字体排印（Typography）：Glimmer 的字体样式体系采用少量精心调整的正文（Body）与标题（Title）样式，通过优化字偶间距、字号和字重，提升阅读与辨认的清晰度。

E. 图标（Iconography）：采用圆角风格的 Material Symbols，与圆润的字体风格保持一致。

开始实现

准备在应用中使用这些组件？请参阅Jetpack Compose Glimmer 开发文档。
bodyEn:
Components are purpose-built building blocks for building your UI. Your app should utilize Jetpack Compose Glimmer for components as they are optimized for the unique use cases of displays on AI glasses.

Optimized components

Glimmer components are optimized for transparent displays in a variety of ways:

A. Surface color: Surfaces need to have transparency, so the opaque surface color here would be changed to black to make it transparent.

B. Outline & Highlight: The Outline color is optimized for contrast. The use of a highlight provides visual expression and might be used to indicate some types of input.

C. Shape: A softer shape system is used to improve glanceability by reducing the sharpness of corners and improving comfort. On Surface color: The On Surface color of content is white to maximize contrast against the world.

D. Typography: Glimmer's typography scale uses a small set of refined Body and Title styles that optimize kerning, size and weight for optimal readability & legibility.

E. Iconography: The use of rounded Material Symbols coheres with the rounded typography scale.

Get started

Ready to implement components? Check out the Jetpack Compose Glimmer documentation.

title: 按钮
description: 明确表达可执行的操作，并通过不同状态及时反馈用户输入。
body:
按钮是向用户表达“这里可以执行操作”的主要视觉元素。

设计原则

操作明确：按钮应清楚表达它会触发一项操作。

反馈清晰：悬停、按下、获得焦点等交互状态，必须在外观上有明确区别，让用户立即获得反馈。

风格一致：所有按钮应共享一致的核心视觉语言，让用户一眼就能认出。

灵活适配：按钮组件应支持图标、不同尺寸等常见变化，同时保持一致性。

使用与布局

按钮应靠近与它相关的内容。它既可以独立放置，也可以与卡片、列表等组件组合使用。

图标按钮

图标按钮可以降低内容密度。只有当图标能清楚表达操作含义时，才适合单独使用；否则，应加上文字标签。

切换按钮

对于收藏等只有两种状态的操作，每一种按钮类型都提供可切换的变体。切换状态时相应更换图标，可以让变化更容易被一眼察觉，反馈也更明确。

组件构成

普通按钮由文字标签组成，也可以在文字前方或后方添加图标。

图标按钮只包含一个容易辨认的图标。普通按钮和图标按钮都提供可切换状态的变体。

默认按钮

Buttons are the primary visual indicator for a user's actions.

Principles

Action-Oriented: Buttons should clearly communicate that they trigger an action.

Clear Feedback: The button's appearance must change distinctly across different interaction states (hover, press, focus) to provide immediate feedback.

Consistent: All buttons should share a core visual language to be instantly recognizable.

Flexible: The button component should accommodate common variations, such as including icons and different sizes, without sacrificing consistency.

Usage & Placement

A button should be placed closely to its relevant content. They can be placed alone or with other components, like cards and lists.

Do

Use progressive disclosure to reveal less relevant actions.

Don't

Overwhelm the user's view with too many buttons. Use a button group instead.

Don't

Use a button as a static decorative element.

Icon buttons

Icon buttons are available to reduce content density. Use icon buttons when the icon clearly illustrates an action, otherwise include a button label.

Do

Use an icon button for common highly recognizable actions.

Don't

Use an icon button for very obscure actions.

Toggable

For actions with boolean states, like favorite, a toggle variant is available for each button type. Swapping icons in between toggle states makes the interaction glanceable and responsive.

Do

Use a toggle button if there are boolean options for an action. Like start/stop.

Don't

title: 按钮组
description: 将相关操作组织在同一容器内，统一管理按钮的布局、焦点与移动。
body:
按钮组提供一个可在按钮之间导航的容器。

说明：此组件目前尚未包含在 Jetpack Compose Glimmer 组件库中，但已经提供设计指南与 Figma 组件，供设计时使用。

设计原则

围绕操作组织：按钮组包含可执行操作的按钮，而不是一组文字标签。

形成整体：通过统一的动效与焦点行为，将相关操作组织在一起。

组合灵活：可以包含多种按钮类型。

使用与布局

当界面需要显示多个按钮时，应使用按钮组组件统一组织，而不是分别独立排列。

按钮组可以组合任意类型的按钮，但所有按钮的高度应保持一致。

按钮组可以与卡片或堆栈等元素搭配，为其提供相关操作。

按钮组可以容纳 1 至 10 个按钮，布局分为完整显示和溢出显示两种。

A. 完整显示（Contained）：整组按钮都能放进容器宽度内，没有元素被裁切。

B. 溢出显示（Overflow）：按钮组的总宽度超出容器的可用空间。

焦点

初始焦点默认落在最左侧按钮上；对于对称布局的按钮组，也可以将初始焦点设置在中间。

居中布局以初始焦点元素为中心排列；每次滑动时，焦点随之移动。居中布局应完整显示所有按钮，因此不要使用溢出显示。

左对齐布局在起始和结束两侧分别保留距边缘 44 dp 的外边距。滑动时，按钮分 3 步平滑移向中心。

译者注：原文还有“and ramp up as they slide”（随滑动逐渐增强），但未说明哪项属性增强。

组件构成

按钮组是一个容器组件，可组合 1 至 10 个类型任意、高度一致的按钮。更多说明参见按钮指南。

自定义

按钮组可以任意组合不同类型的按钮，前提是它们的高度一致。

属性可自定义默认值
初始焦点是0

A button group provides a navigable container of buttons.

Note: This component is not yet available in Jetpack Compose Glimmer library, but the design guidance and Figma component is available to explore.

Principles

Action-Oriented: Contains actionable buttons, rather than groups of labels.

Containment: Groups actions together with motion and focus.

Flexible: Can consist of multiple button types.

Usage & Placement

Use a button group to display more than one button. When presenting multiple buttons, use a button group component rather than laying each out independently.

A button group can consist of any combination of button types of the same button height.

Do

Keep button heights consistent in a button group.

Don't

Group buttons of different heights together.

Button groups can be paired with other elements, like cards or stacks, to act as related actions.

Do

Keep to one button group per layout.

Don't

Stack multiple button groups.

A button group layout can be contained or overflow, with 1 to 10 buttons.

A. Contained: The button group fits within the container's width without any elements cut off.

B. Overflow: The button group's width is wider than the space available in the container.

Do

Keep your buttons under 10 and essential only to minimize swipes.

Don't

Grow the button group past 10 buttons.

Focus

Initial focus defaults to the left most button, but can be configured to be centered for symmetrical button groups.

Do

Configure focus to highlight most access or higher importance features.

Don't

Override default initial focus if all items are of similar use case importance.

A center aligned button group based on the initial focus element, that slides focus over per swipe. Avoid using an overflow layout, as all buttons should be visable and contained in a centered layout.

Left aligned button group layout include start and end margins of 44dp from edges. Buttons smoothly scroll over to the center over 3 steps on swipe and ramp up as they slide.

Anatomy

The button group is a container component, grouping 1 to 10 buttons of any type and consistent height. For more on buttons, read the button guidance.

Customization

A button group set can consist of any combination of button types of the same button height.

卡片可以承载多种信息，包括文字、图标、图片、Gemini 回答和操作。

内容相关：将相关信息与操作组合成一个容易理解的单元。

层次清楚：有条理地呈现内容，便于快速浏览。

适应多种内容：既能承载简短文字，也能呈现由多个元素组成的复杂摘要。

使用与布局

注意：应尽可能避免自行另建卡片组件。

需要提供多个操作时，应让卡片与按钮组搭配使用。

组件构成

卡片使用预设的内容槽位模板构建。

1. 顶部区域（Header）：位于卡片顶部，用于放置图片。

2. 标题与副标题：分别提供卡片的主要与次要文字标签。

3. 前置图标：可选，位于卡片内容区域的起始位置。

4. 后置图标：可选，位于卡片内容区域的末尾。

6. 主内容（Main Content）：卡片的核心内容区域，用于放置主要文字或其他内容。

焦点

bodyEn:
Cards can contain a wide-variety of information like text, icons, images, Gemini responses, or actions.

Principles

Cohesive: Cards group related information and actions into a single, digestible unit.

Clear: They present content in a clear, organized manner, enhancing scannability.

Versitile: Cards can adapt to display a wide range of content, from small text blurbs to more complex summaries with multiple elements.

Modular: Designed to be modular and reusable across different parts of the Jetpack Compose Glimmer for Glasses interface.

Usage & Placement

Cards can contain a wide-variety of information like text, icons, images, actions or Gemini responses.

Use Jetpack Compose Glimmer card templates for content as they are come in many variations and optimized to follow glasses design principles out of the box.

Warning: Avoid building custom card components if possible.

Do

Keep content succinct and mindful of style best practices, like color usage.

Don't

Overwhelm users with too much content within cards or abandon style guidelines.

Use a button group with a card to display more than one action.

Do

Have exactly one nested button in a card for clearer focus.

Don't

Have multiple buttons within a card. Cards shouldn't be treated as a mobile dialog.

Anatomy

Cards are built with pre-set slot templates.

1. Header: The top section of the card, designed to hold an image. 

2. Title and Subtitle: These text fields provide the main and secondary labels for the card. 

3. Leading Icon: An optional icon that appears at the beginning of the card's content area.

4. Trailing Icon: An optional icon that appears at the end of the card's content area.

5. Action: A slot for a primary interactive element, such as a Button. This allows users to perform an action directly from the card. If a card has an action, it should only contain a single action.

6. Main Content: The core body of the card, where you place the primary Text or other content.

Focus

For cards whose primary purpose is to house a specific interactive element (like the Button in the Action), focus should go directly to that element, not the card container. A card becomes focusable when it represents a single, navigable item, such as an entry in a list. This provides a more direct and accessible user experience.

A card that has focus as a list item.

A button within a card is given focus as the actionable element.

Customization

Border Yes 2 dp, #606460

Leading icon Yes 56 dp
Trailing icon Yes 56 dp

title: 图标标记
description: 将界面信息关联到现实物体或空间位置，帮助用户理解周围环境。
body:
图标标记属于空间标注体系，用于标注现实世界中的物体。

设计原则

关联现实：图标标记固定在现实物体或空间中的某个位置上。

表达简洁：用精简的视觉符号表示一个空间锚点。

使用与布局

图标标记的外观类似图标按钮，用来标出用户周围值得关注的物体。它是一种用于空间锚定的空间标记。

图标标记可以与任意其他 Jetpack Compose Glimmer 组件搭配，为用户周围的环境提供更清楚、深入的信息。

内容和标签可以沿不同方向放置。图标标记及其附属界面都应遵循空间界面的行为：使用恒定的角度 dp 尺寸，并让界面尺寸体现被标注物体的实际距离。

标记应清楚易辨，并限制视野内同时出现的标记数量，避免视觉杂乱。如果需要多个标记，应将它们聚合成一个更显眼的标记，再让用户逐步查看。

状态

图标标记与图标按钮非常相似。主要区别在于：图标标记使用“不可交互”状态，而不是“禁用”状态。

使用不可交互状态标注现实世界，例如标出一个兴趣点。

如果还有更多信息可供查看，可以使用带有按钮操作暗示的可交互状态。用户轻点图标标记后，会出现一张包含更多信息的 Glimmer 卡片。

组件构成

图标标记本身是一个小型图标按钮式元素，通过内边距建立固定的界面对齐与朝向关系。标记也可以用大圆点或小圆点替代图标。可交互状态会加入视觉上的操作暗示，让用户认出它具有按钮行为。

内边距

横向或纵向排列的附属界面使用 Medium 内边距；沿对角线方向搭配的元素，默认内边距为 0 dp。

对齐

附属界面可以放在标记的水平、垂直或对角线方向。

朝向

内容应始终面向用户，并保持符合重力方向的姿态，让布局显得有序。

自定义

为保持一致的操作暗示，应避免自定义图标标记。不过，可以调整附属界面元素的朝向与对齐方式。

属性可自定义默认值
图标是大圆点、小圆点、图标
内边距否上中、右中、下中、左中：Medium
左上、右上、右下、左下：0 dp
对齐是TopLeft、TopCenter、TopRight、CenterLeft、CenterRight、BottomLeft、BottomCenter、BottomRight
朝向是RotateToLookAtUser：无论旋转角度如何，圆点始终朝向用户
bodyEn:
The icon marker is part of the spatial annotation system. Use icon markers to help annotate real world objects.

Principles

Contextual: Icon markers are locked to real world objects or points.

Concise: Icon markers are abbreviated visual indicators of a spatial anchor.

Usage & Placement

An icon marker is an icon-button-like UI element that marks objects of interest in the user's environment. The icon marker is a type of spatial marker, used for spatial anchoring.

Do

Use an icon marker to annotate real world objects.

Don't

Use icon markers for decorative elements or non-real world object annotation, when an icon button is better suited.

Any other Jetpack Compose Glimmer component can be paired with a marker for greater clarification or insight on the user's surroundings.

Do

Use progressive disclosure to allow the user to navigate through to further information.

Don't

Overload markers with additional UI, this will cause greater interference with the user's environment.

Content and labels can be placed at different orientations. Markers, and any attached UI, should behave as spatial UI, meaning the actual distance of the marked object should be reflected in the size of the UI, using a constant angular DP size.

Clearly define markers to avoid visual clutter, and limit the number of markers within view. If multiple markers are needed, cluster them together as one, more-prominent marker that can be progressively viewed.

States

The icon marker is very similar to an icon button. The main difference is that rather than a disabled state, it has a non-interactive state.

Annotate the physical world with the non-interactive state, like marking a point of interest.

If there is more information that might be available, you can use the interactive state that has a button affordance. If the user taps the icon marker, a Glimmer card with more information is displayed.

Anatomy

The icon marker itself is a small icon button UI element with padding allowing for a fixed UI alignment and orientation. The icon marker can also use a large or small dot instead of an icon. The interactive state includes a visual affordance to denote the button state.

Padding

Horizontal and vertically positioned UI have a medium padding, while diagonally paired elements have a 0 dp default padding.

Alignment

UI elements can be positioned at horizontal, vertical, or diagonal points.

Orientation

Content should billboard toward the user, while respecting gravity to make the content feel organized.

Customization

To keep a consistent visual affordance, avoid customizing icon markers. However, you can customize the orientation and alignment of the attached UI elements.

Padding No Top Center, Center Right, Bottom Center, Center Left = medium Top Left, Top Right, Bottom Right, Bottom Left = 0 dp
Alignment Yes TopLeft, TopCenter, TopRight, CenterLeft, CenterRight, BottomLeft, BottomCenter, BottomRight
Orientation Yes RotateToLookAtUser: The dot billboards towards the user no matter angle of rotation.

title: 列表
description: 通过一致排列、内置滚动与清晰焦点，组织多个同级内容。
body:
列表是承载一组元素的容器，内置滚动与焦点行为。

设计原则

组织清晰：以清楚、便于扫读的纵向排列呈现信息。

项目一致：各列表项应使用一致的视觉结构。

焦点与导航明确：对于依赖方向切换的界面，列表必须清楚标出当前获得焦点的项目。

支持交互：列表项通常代表可选择的内容或可执行的操作。

使用与布局

列表可以容纳多种同级内容，并使用可重复的元素结构。与堆栈不同，列表会填满应用视图的容器。

用遮罩提示还有更多内容。当列表项目超过当前视图可容纳的范围时，在列表边缘使用黑色遮罩。

必要时为列表添加标题。可以使用静态标题或吸顶标题，帮助用户理解内容。

用深度表达焦点

列表项在未获得焦点时使用深度 0，获得焦点时使用深度 +4，并在两种状态间过渡。

列表项可以直接执行操作

列表项本身可以代表一项操作，应将操作归于该列表项。

应高亮轻点时实际会被触发的控件，即使此时还能滚动其他内容。如果列表或卡片能够在另一元素后方滚动，也应只让响应轻点的项目获得焦点。

组件构成

列表由可滚动容器和间距一致的列表项组成。当内容超出视口时，应采用纵向滚动，并尽量减小越界滚动的幅度。

A. 容器：可滚动区域。
B. 列表项。
C. 系统栏。

列表项是列表中的每一个独立元素，包含：
A. 形状。
B. 边框。
C. 前置图标。
D. 文字内容。
E. 后置指示元素。

自定义

列表的大部分自定义设置都作用于列表项。

属性可自定义默认值
列表项：形状是40 dp
列表项：前置与后置图标是Medium Symbol Icon
列表项：内边距是2d dp、20 dp（原文如此）
列表项：内容是单行：一个 Text 组件，以 Body Small 呈现主标签。
双行：一个 Column 内包含两个 Text 组件，分别呈现主标签与次标签。
主标签：Title Small；次标签：Body Small。
列表：纵向排列间距（verticalArrangement）是20 dp

bodyEn:
Lists are containers of elements with built-in scrolling and focus.

Principles

Clear Organization: Lists should present information in a clear scannable vertical arrangement.

Consistent Item Presentation: List items should follow a consistent visual structure.

Focusability & Navigation: In interfaces relying on directional navigation, lists must clearly indicate the focused item.

Interactivity: List items often represent selectable or actionable elements.

Usage & Placement

Lists can contain various sibling content with repeatable elements. Unlike stacks, lists fill the app view container.

Use scrims to indicate overflow content When a list contains more items than will fit within a view, a black scrim is used near the list's bounds.

Lists can use a title if necessary A static or sticky title can be used in a list for clarity.

Don't

Have more than one list per view, this is overwhelming visually and focus wise.

Use depth to indicate focus

List items move between 0 and +4 depth for unfocused and focused states.

List items can be actionable

Items in a list can act as actions. Keep the action to the list item

Highlight the control that will be activated on tap, even if you can scroll something else. If a list or card can be scrolled behind another element, only focus the item that responds to tap.

Do

Only highlight the currently focused element, This allows users to discover focusable controls.

Don't

Highlight multiple focusable UI elements as this is confusing what is linked to tap input.

Anatomy

List is composed of a scrolling container and consistently spaced list items. Lists should vertically scroll, with minimal overshoot, when the number of items exceeds the viewport.

A. Container - scrollable area

B. List item

C. System bars

List Item: Each individual element within the list.

A. Shape

B. Border 

C. Leading icon

D. Text content

E. Trailing indicator

Customization

The majority of customization happens with list items.

title: 分页指示器
description: 在横向分页内容中显示当前页与总页数，帮助用户理解所处位置。
body:
分页指示器显示当前页与总页数，配合可横向切换内容的浮层使用。

设计原则

译者注：原文此处写作“Stack（堆栈）是容器组件，与卡片和列表共享设计原则”，但本页介绍的是分页指示器。

反馈清晰：让用户知道自己在一组可轮播内容中的当前位置。

交代上下文：分页指示器的主要作用，是为关联内容即时提供清晰的上下文信息。

表达精简：分页指示器体积小巧，视觉表达简洁准确。

使用与布局

分页指示器显示用户在线性内容序列中的当前位置。

分页指示器位于系统栏区域上方、内容区域下方。

同一时刻只应显示一张卡片。

组件构成

分页指示器由一排圆点组成，分别呈现当前页与非当前页的状态。

A. 当前页：激活状态。
B. 其他页面：未激活状态。

当圆点达到 5 个或更多时，会用较小的首个圆点提示还有其他页面。整排圆点随翻页移动，直到到达末页。

自定义

分页组件内置的遮罩、分页行为与动效不支持自定义；可以自定义的是容器内展示的内容。
bodyEn:
The page indicator represents the currently active page and total pages of an overlay that lets you navigate horizontally between content.

Principles

Stack are a container component, so they share design principles with cards and lists:

Clear Feedback: Pagers communicate where the user is within a carousel of content.

Contextual: The primary purpose of a pager is to provide clear and immediate context for the content it's associated with.

Concise: Pagers are small and precise in visual language.

Usage & Placement

Pagers show the user their current position within a linear sequence of content.

They are placed above the system bar area and under the content area.

Do

Cards are arranged in a row with no overlap

Don't

Allow cards to overlap. Only one card is visible at a time.

Anatomy

A pager is composed of a row of indication dots in active and inactive states.

A. Active (Current page)

B. Inactive page

When five or more dots are present, the additional dots are indicated with a smaller first dot and slide the entire row until the end is reached.

Customization

Pagers have built-in scrim, paging, and animations that can't be customized. Rather the content within the stacks pager is customized.

title: 进度指示器
description: 以确定或不确定进度反馈过程状态，适用于耗时已知或未知的情况。
body:
进度指示器用于表达某个过程的进行状态，无论其所需时间是否已知。

设计原则

反馈清晰：即时提供反馈。

风格一致：所有进度指示器应共享一致的核心视觉语言，让用户立即认出。

表达灵活：通过多种形态与状态，适应不同的进度表达需求。

使用与布局

进度指示器实时显示任务状态。

当所需时间已知时，可以显示确定进度，例如计时器。

当所需时间未知时，可以显示不确定进度，例如加载过程。

组件构成

1. 确定进度的终点标记：指明明确的结束位置。
2. 当前进度。
3. 尚未完成的部分。
4. 不确定进度。
5. 线形。
6. 环形。

自定义

除了确定与不确定两种进度模式，还提供线形、环形与波浪形等外观变体。

1. 波浪形。
2. 直线形。

波浪形与直线形进度指示器使用相同的属性、自定义选项和默认值，具体如下。

线形

属性可自定义默认值
线宽是6 dp
进度颜色是Primary
轨道颜色是Outline
尺寸是360 dp

环形

属性可自定义默认值
线宽是6 dp
进度颜色是Primary
轨道颜色是Outline
尺寸是40 dp
bodyEn:
The progress indicator communicates the status of a known or unknown process time.

Principles

Clear Feedback: The progress indicator provides immediate feedback.

Consistent: All progress indicators should share a core visual language to be instantly recognizable.

Flexible: Variety of progress indicators and states provide flexibility to communicate progress.

Usage & Placement

Progress indicators show the status of a process in real time.

Indication can express determinate progress, with a known process time, like a timer.

Or indeterminate progress, with unknown process time, like loading.

Do

Use an indeterminate progress indication to show unknown processing times, like loading.

Don't

Use a determinate indicator when the processing time is unknown. This will give users a false sense of progress.

Do

Keep to one progress indicator at a time when there is sufficient time or progress to communicate.

Don't

Overuse progress indicators or use them when there isn't sufficient time and progress to communicate.

Anatomy

1. Determinate progress stop - shows the definite endpoint.
2. Current progress
3. Future progress
4. Indeterminate processing
5. Linear
6. Circular

Customization

Besides determinate and indeterminate, progress indicators also come in linear, circular, and wavy variations.

1. Wavy
2. Linear

All of the wavy and linear variants of progress indicators share the same properties, customization options, and defaults. The following table describes these details.

Linear

Properties Customization Defaults
Thickness Yes 6 dp
Indicator color Yes Primary
Track color Yes Outline
Size Yes 360 dp

Circular

Properties Customization Defaults
Thickness Yes 6 dp
Indicator color Yes Primary
Track color Yes Outline
Size Yes 40 dp

title: 堆栈
description: 将多条内容收起为层叠结构，每次显示一项，并通过滑动逐项浏览。
body:
堆栈是一种收起的列表，以层叠形式呈现通知、卡片等内容，每次只显示一项。

设计原则

堆栈属于容器组件，因此与卡片、列表共享以下设计原则。

组织相关内容：将相关信息与操作组合成一个容易理解的单元。

聚焦且清晰：以清楚、集中的方式呈现内容。

适应多种内容：可以展示卡片，也可以展示通知。

表现一致：保持一致的视觉结构。

使用与布局

堆栈既能让用户知道列表中收起了多个项目，又能减少视野里同时出现的视觉元素。它提供两种变体：

  • 卡片堆栈。
  • 通知堆栈。

两种变体都是容器组件，外观和行为应基本一致。容器内置分页逻辑，负责组织这些内容。

浏览堆栈

用户沿触控板前后滑动或拖动，即可浏览堆栈。每次滚动只切换一个项目。

响应触控输入时，堆栈可以通过垂直移动逐项显示内容，也可以转为列表，同时展示多个元素。列表应采用默认的容器与焦点状态。

用深度表达焦点

下方项目的深度为 0，最上方项目的深度为 +2。

组件构成

作为分页组件，堆栈始终以收起状态呈现。除非内部嵌套了一个可用按钮，否则最上方项目始终是主要焦点，并以更明显的边框和深度突出显示。

到达堆栈首尾后继续滑动，会出现标准拉伸动效，提示用户已经到达起点或终点。

自定义

堆栈内置的遮罩、分页行为和动效不支持自定义；可以自定义的是堆栈中的内容。
bodyEn:
A stack is a collapsed list that only displays one piece of content at a time, in a stacked visual, such as a notification or card.

Principles

Stack are a container component, so they share design principles with cards and lists:

Containment: Stacks group related information and actions into a single, digestible unit.

Focused & Clarity: They present content in a clear, focused manner.

Versatility: Stacks can display cards and notifications.

Consistent Presentation: Stacks follow a consistent visual structure.

Usage & Placement

Stacks are a way to showcase to users that there are multiple elements collapsed in a list while minimizing the visual elements within view. There are two different variants of stacks: 

  • Card stacks

  • Notification stacks

Stacks are a container component, both versions don't act or look differently. 

Both should look and act nearly identical. The stack is a container for these controls with built-in logic for pagination. 

Stack navigation

Users navigate by swiping or dragging along the touchpad forward and backward. Scrolling the stack will move through only one item at a time.

Stacks can traversed one item at a time.

Upon touch input, stacks are able to present one item at a time by moving vertically, and become lists to show more than one element at a time. The list should use default containers and focus states.

Use depth to indicate focus

Lower stack items use a depth of 0 while the top most item uses a depth of +2.

Anatomy

A stack is always collapsed as a pagination component. The top item is always the primary focus, showing the stronger border depth, unless there is a nested enabled button.

Swiping past the start or end of a stack shows the standard stretch animation, reinforcing the beginning or end of a stack.

Customization

Stacks have built-in scrim, paging, and animations that can't be customized. Rather the content within the stacks is customized.

Do

Retain opacity of UI elements as they scroll to reduce visual noise.

Don't

Adjust opacity on stack items on scroll.

title: 语音状态指示器
description: 以可见反馈告诉用户麦克风是否正在接收输入。
body:
语音输入指示器将用户的音频输入转化为可见的反馈。

设计原则

反馈清晰：立即让用户知道麦克风正在接收输入。

风格一致：所有指示器应共享一致的核心视觉语言，让用户立即认出。

使用与布局

语音输入指示器显示应用是否正在使用麦克风。它只负责呈现状态，不负责控制麦克风。

带底板和不带底板的两种指示器都可以独立使用，无需依附于卡片等其他界面底板。

放在卡片中时

卡片只有 1 或 2 行内容时，应将语音输入指示器垂直居中对齐。

卡片有 2 行或更多内容时，应将语音输入指示器固定在卡片右上角。

译者注：原文两项位置规则在“2 行”时重叠，未说明应采用哪一项。
译者注：原文要求“使用红色”，同时又将红色保留给系统级警告，前后含义冲突。

组件构成

自定义

可以根据放置位置与品牌风格，自定义语音指示器是否显示底板以及所用颜色。

属性可自定义默认值
显示底板是False（不显示）
颜色是Primary
bodyEn:
Voice input indicator visualizes audio input from the user.

Principles

Clear Feedback: The indicator provides immediate feedback to show the user the microphone is receiving input.

Consistent: All indicators should share a core visual language to be instantly recognizable.

Usage & Placement

The voice input indicator communicates whether the app is actively accessing the microphone. The indicator doesn't control the microphone.

Both contained and uncontained indicators can be used independently without any accompanying surface, like a card.

Do

Use uncontained indicator on a card or button.

Don't

Use indicator with container on colored surface.

If displayed on a card

Align the voice input indicator to the vertical center if there are 1 or 2 content rows.

Anchor the voice input indicator to the top right corner of the card if there are 2 or more content rows.

Do

Use the color to match the app's primary brand color.

Warning

Use red for voice input indicator, which is reserved for system-level warning, unless the branding color is red.

Anatomy

Voice indicator with container and without container

Customization

The voice indicator container and color can be customized depending on placement and branding.

Properties Customization Defaults
Show container Yes False
Color Yes Primary
